card.name: Mechanism and biochemistry explanation phrases
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of sentences that explain biological mechanisms or metabolism, such as 'involved', 'metabolized', 'genetic', 'in vitro', 'biochemical' and 'have been' before 'implicated'. It fires in drug-label and science text.

modes.label: Metabolism and enzyme wording
modes.description: Verb or word ending describing how a drug is metabolized or accumulates.
modes.example: caution is indicated in the combined use of nefazodone with any drugs known to be metabol<<ized>> by CYP3A4.

modes.label: Mechanism-of-action phrasing
modes.description: Adjectives or verbs in sentences about pathways, genes or proposed mechanisms.
modes.example: Though the mechanism of OIH is not fully understood, multiple<< biochemical>> pathways have been implicated.
